title: The Monotonic Watchtower
statement:
A sequence of N watchtowers stands along a border. For each watchtower i, the guards look to the right to find the nearest watchtower that is strictly taller than tower i.

If a taller tower exists to the right, output its height. If no such tower exists, output -1.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: Print N space-separated integers representing the Next Greater Element for each position.

sampleCases.explanation: Next greater elements to the right.
